def filter_api_calls(log_probs_no_call, log_probs_call_only, log_probs_call_with_result, tau_filter):
    """
    Implements the Toolformer loss-filter procedure.

    Parameters
    ----------
    log_probs_no_call : np.ndarray
        Shape (n_candidates, future_horizon), nonpositive, finite.
    log_probs_call_only : np.ndarray
        Same shape.
    log_probs_call_with_result : np.ndarray
        Same shape.
    tau_filter : float
        Nonnegative finite threshold, must not be bool.

    Returns
    -------
    keep : np.ndarray
        Boolean mask of shape (n_candidates,).
    margins : np.ndarray
        Float margins of shape (n_candidates,), finite.
    """
    # Validate inputs
    for name, mat in [('log_probs_no_call', log_probs_no_call),
                      ('log_probs_call_only', log_probs_call_only),
                      ('log_probs_call_with_result', log_probs_call_with_result)]:
        if not isinstance(mat, np.ndarray):
            raise ValueError(f'{name} must be a NumPy array')
        if mat.ndim != 2:
            raise ValueError(f'{name} must be a 2D matrix')
        if mat.size == 0:
            raise ValueError(f'{name} must not be empty')
        if not np.isfinite(mat).all():
            raise ValueError(f'{name} contains nonfinite values')
        if (mat > 0).any():
            raise ValueError(f'{name} contains positive log probabilities')

    shapes = [log_probs_no_call.shape, log_probs_call_only.shape, log_probs_call_with_result.shape]
    if len(set(shapes)) != 1:
        raise ValueError('All three matrices must have the same shape')

    if not isinstance(tau_filter, (int, float)) or isinstance(tau_filter, bool):
        raise ValueError('tau_filter must be a non-boolean numeric')
    if not np.isfinite(tau_filter) or tau_filter < 0:
        raise ValueError('tau_filter must be a finite nonnegative number')

    n_candidates, future_horizon = log_probs_no_call.shape

    # Normalized decreasing weights
    t = np.arange(future_horizon, dtype=float)
    raw_weights = np.maximum(0.0, 1.0 - 0.2 * t)
    weight_sum = np.sum(raw_weights)
    if weight_sum == 0:
        # If all weights are zero (e.g., horizon=0), handle edge case
        normalized_weights = np.zeros_like(raw_weights)
    else:
        normalized_weights = raw_weights / weight_sum

    # Weighted losses (negative weighted log probabilities)
    loss_no_call = np.dot(-log_probs_no_call, normalized_weights)
    loss_call_only = np.dot(-log_probs_call_only, normalized_weights)
    loss_call_with_result = np.dot(-log_probs_call_with_result, normalized_weights)

    # Stronger counterfactual baseline
    loss_minus = np.minimum(loss_no_call, loss_call_only)

    # Margins
    margins = loss_minus - loss_call_with_result

    # Keep mask
    keep = margins >= tau_filter

    return keep, margins
